## The cmdstan/brms/cpu benchmark

## Results so far

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
res <- read_csv("results.csv")

res |>
  group_by(machine, threads) |>
  summarise(mean_chain = min(mean_chain), .groups = "drop") |>   # cached run = the lower one
  pivot_wider(names_from = threads, values_from = mean_chain, names_prefix = "threads=") |>
  knitr::kable(digits = 1)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.path="figures/", fig.width=7, fig.height=4}

res |>
  group_by(machine, threads) |>
  summarise(mean_chain = min(mean_chain), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(factor(threads), mean_chain, colour = machine, group = machine)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = mean_chain), vjust = -0.9, size = 3, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(20, 60)) +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(x = "threads per chain (4 chains)",
       y = "mean chain time (s)",
       colour = NULL,
       title = "brms Poisson GLMM, 10k rows — seed 1234, CmdStan 2.39") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
